country.name: Panamá
country.languagePolicy: Spanish is the default interface language. Indigenous and intercultural bilingual education must be reviewed with the responsible MEDUCA directorate and the affected community; automatic translation is not treated as reviewed localization.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Panamanian reviewer, a current authoritative source and confirmation of the responsible national, regional or institutional authority.

governanceModel.summary: Panama's education system combines MEDUCA national and regional administration, legally established official universities, private-university oversight and institution- or program-specific accreditation. One listing must not be treated as blanket approval of every institution or program.
governanceModel.regionalAuthorityRule: Record the responsible MEDUCA regional directorate and local implementation guidance when it applies.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Verify legal operating status and accreditation separately for the particular university or program and its effective period.

authorities.name: Ministerio de Educación
authorities.role: national education authority, curriculum, school statistics and non-university higher education oversight

authorities.name: Dirección Nacional de Currículo y Tecnología Educativa
authorities.role: official plans and programs of study

authorities.name: Consejo Nacional de Evaluación y Acreditación Universitaria de Panamá
Autoridad Nacional de Transparencia y Acceso a la Información
authorities.role: personal-data protection authority under Law 81 of 2019

authorities.name: Secretaría Nacional de Niñez, Adolescencia y Familia
authorities.role: child and adolescent protection system participant

curriculum.title: Planes y programas de estudio
curriculum.regionalImplementationRule: Confirm current calendars, implementation guidance, adaptations and applicable regional instructions with MEDUCA.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: External materials may supplement but never replace, waive or silently reinterpret controlling requirements.

schoolDirectory.primarySourceName: Estadísticas educativas y directorios de centros educativos
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: MEDUCA publishes statistical bulletins, open data and dated school directories. BRASA must display the source year and publication date and must not infer present operating status or authorization from an older directory.
requiredRecordFields: official or institutional URL when available

higherEducation.authorityNotice: Institutional status, legal operation and program accreditation are distinct. Each claim must identify the institution or program, controlling resolution, effective period and source review date.

qualityAssurance.authority: Consejo Nacional de Evaluación y Acreditación Universitaria de Panamá
qualityAssurance.notice: Accredited, reaccredited, in-process, not operating and closed institutions are different statuses. BRASA must preserve the exact published status and effective dates.

privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Law 81 data-protection duties and Panama's child-protection framework must be reviewed alongside institutional consent, safeguarding and incident procedures before real learner participation.

completionCriteria: A qualified Panamanian education reviewer is named.
MEDUCA national and regional implementation boundaries are reviewed and approved.
Every school record displays directory year, publication date, provenance and review date.
Every institution and program claim preserves its exact legal or accreditation status, resolution and effective period.
Curriculum mappings are reviewed by level, subject and current MEDUCA implementation context.
Comarca, indigenous-language and intercultural bilingual requirements are reviewed with competent community participation.
Privacy, child protection, accessibility, incident and consent procedures are approved by the participating institution and applicable authority.
No accreditation, recognition, partnership or credential claim exceeds documentary evidence.
